status: experimental turn-order options (not final; see TURN_ORDER_REPORT.md). 'Standard' is added by the game itself.

rulesets.name: Fair start A (trial)
rulesets.desc: Trial rule, recommended by simulation: the first player gets a 2-point bonus at the end, so the second player must win 10–6 or better to win outright (9–7 is a draw).

rulesets.name: Fair start B (trial)
rulesets.desc: Trial rule: the 16th and last placement has Attack −1 (to take away the second player's unanswerable final strike). No bonus points.
